verdict.rationale: Anytype ships native iOS and Android apps (docs-54, comm-7). The whole local vault syncs between desktop and mobile, over P2P or local-only mode (docs-30, comm-9, comm-8), so the full knowledge base reaches the phone. Users describe the mobile apps as well-crafted and working well (comm-1, comm-3), but nothing shows that capture, search and linking on mobile match desktop rather than being a reduced companion. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of mobile feature parity, mobile-specific capture flows, documented mobile search and linking/backlinks, hands-on power-user mobile reports.
